1479-5700-5701-6763-8293.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5700-5701-6763-8293.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

339-677-6791-8249.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4068-4770-5301-6006.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
4068-4770-5301-6006.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

510-2281-4247.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Mistmoon Griffin.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Mistmoon Griffin.
When Mistmoon Griffin dies, it and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Mistmoon Griffin from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Mistmoon Griffin trigger, failing to exile it as it is not in your graveyard and then returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

1170-4908-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4908-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Enthusiastic Mechanaut.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

757-4883-5087-7798.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-4883-5087-7798.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Contagion Clasp to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Natural Emergence, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

1170-1636-7490-7875.description:
Cast Rejoinder using Party Thrasher's convoke ability by tapping creatures you control.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Elite Interceptor.
When Elite Interceptor enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2034-3755-6970-7730-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

2301-2946-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2301-2946-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3129-5220-6961-7396.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-3129-5220-6961-7396.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1250-6267-7201.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have one or more basic land cards in your library.
1250-6267-7201.description:
Cast Scouting Trek by paying {1}{G}, searching your library for all basic land cards and putting them onto the top of your library.
Play a land.
When the land enters, Sapling Nursery triggers, creating a 3/4 Treefolk creature token.
When the Treefolk enters, Fecund Greenshell triggers, putting the top card of your library onto the battlefield tapped as it will be a land.
Repeat from step 3 until the top card of your library isn't a land.

4050-4907-6747-6989.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
4050-4907-6747-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Sami. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static effect.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

2921-3220-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2921-3220-7084.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Golgari Germination and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4681-5170-5686-5933.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Popular Egotist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

3812-5963-7066.description:
Activate Marvin using Avatar Kyoshi's ability by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2350-3532-4842-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Chasm Skulker triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

560-2034-2267-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
560-2034-2267-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

431-1308-2557-6441.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-2557-6441.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1274-1818-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-1818-5641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1836-4311-4423-6618.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three Islands.
1836-4311-4423-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mystic Sanctuary.
When the Mystic Sanctuary token enters the battlefield untapped, it triggers, putting Relm's Sketching from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Activate the Mystic Sanctuary token by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Activate the original Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, causing you to add {U} for each other Mystic Sanctuary you control.
Repeat steps 1 through 4.

372-4681-6558.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Naga Fleshcrafter.
372-4681-6558.description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Put the original Abdel Adrian into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Naga Fleshcrafter's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter ability, choosing to exile Karmic Guide until Naga Fleshcrafter leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Abdel Adrian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Naga Fleshcrafter into your graveyard due to the legend rule, causing Karmic Guide to return to the battlefield from exile.
Karmic Guide and Abdel Adrian's abilities trigger.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian ability, exiling Karmic Guide until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Karmic Guide trigger, returning Naga Fleshcrafter from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-5315-6351--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-5315-6351--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Teval triggers. Holding priority, activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

1887-2793-5089-5668-6320.description:
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Saheeli's first ability triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli's second ability triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus that is a 5/5 artifact creature.
Put the nontoken Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it.
At the beginning of the end step, Saheeli triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Ugin's Nexus token. The token put into exile due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your first extra turn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, putting Ugin's Nexus into your hand from exile.
Move to your second extra turn, and repeat from step 1.

1357-1534-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1357-1534-4821.description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Twincast by paying {U}{U}, creating a copy of Dramatic Reversal.
Activate Errant by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Dramatic Reversal copy.
Resolve the first Dramatic Reversal copy, untapping all nonland permanents you control.
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Repeat from step 4.

176-2292-3000.easyPrerequisites: You control an additional non-Spirit creature.
176-2292-3000.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a non-Spirit creature
When the creature dies, Requiem Angel triggers, creating two creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability
Repeat.

618-4242-4499-5256.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping itself, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing copy of Su-Chi.
Su-Chi triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
 Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

1247-3430-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Paradise Mantle attached to Pili-Pala.
Pili-Pala does not have summoning sickness.
1247-3430-4474.description:
Activate Pili-Pala using Paradise Mantle's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Pili-Pala's other ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding three mana of any one color.
Repeat.
